remarks: Experience elegant living at Schooner Cove, one of Stamford's most prestigious luxury waterfront communities. Nestled on coveted Shippan Point, Schooner Cove offers an unparalleled lifestyle, minutes from sandy beaches, boutique shopping & fine dining. This spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse blends refined style w/coastal charm & serene marina views. Living at Schooner Cove feels like a daily vacation-whether sipping coffee on your deck while watching the swans below, unwinding with some wine while watching the sunset, relaxing by the pool, or walking the charming grounds. The open main level flows to your large private deck off the living room directly overlooking the beautiful waterfront harbor. Inside, enjoy a cozy wood-burning fireplace, sleek modern kitchen w/stainless steel appliances, updated guest half bath, & convenient washer/dryer. The third level primary suite is a private retreat featuring vaulted ceilings, skylights, ceiling fan, walk-in closet & a 2nd private deck w/panoramic harbor views to enjoy day & night. The master spa-inspired bath features extra built-in storage space, walk-in marble shower, & updated high-end finishes for a truly luxurious feel. The additional bedroom on this level offers flexible living space, ideal for even a den or office w/large walk-in closet. The second level bedroom is a true en-suite with updated bath featuring sleek finishes & designer tile. Heat & Hot water are included in the HOA plus additional storage & amble parking.
